field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: The sole entry proves use of unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF Q4_K_M.
field_principles.claim_evidence_trace_ready_score: One means all 48 replayable traces and receipts exist; it makes no verifier-value claim.
field_principles.claim_evidence_trace_rows: Per-unit structures, spans, parse states, direct decisions, and exact labels support CPU replay.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured wall time must reflect the full-generation run.
field_principles.execution_venue: Host and GPU UUID identify the local runtime.
field_principles.field_principles: Field reasons separate authentic capture from later verifier value.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: A blocked result names the exact failed precondition and observed resource state.
field_principles.generation_receipts: Tokens, latency, raw hashes, PID, lease, and CUDA markers prove authentic generation.
field_principles.gpu_telemetry_rows: Before, during, and after snapshots attribute compute to the task-owned process.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Free text distinguishes complete transport from block or incomplete local work.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Use model_full_generation, or blocked_no_run before invocation, because 48 scored generations are real generative work.
field_principles.parser_failure_rows: Failed structured outputs remain visible in the denominator.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Named fixture, cache, runner, GPU, lease, and storage checks prevent fallback.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed controls row selection, decoding, and order.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: The checksum detects fixture, model, prompt, raw-output, or row drift.
field_principles.rows: One row per fixture makes capture coverage and failures recheckable.
field_principles.run_date: The date binds volatile model and GPU state.
field_principles.sealed_schedule_rows: Pre-output IDs, pairs, prompts, budgets, and order prove preregistration.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Hashes bind fixture, model, prompt, code, tests, and raw manifest.
field_principles.status: A terminal state prevents checkpoint-only evidence from passing.
field_principles.teardown_receipt: PID, port, lease, and VRAM release prevent another orphan.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False records that this task captures candidates and does not authorize correctness.
